en.text:
Powered Melee Kills and Finishers grant Nightmare Fuel for 7 seconds.

Gaining Nightmare Fuel grants <pve 35% /> <pvp [20%] /> increased weapon damage (<link Empowering Buff [#DamageBuffs] />), ? Handling, 50 Airborne Effectiveness, and <title refills [G_refill] /> the magazine of all stowed weapons from reserves. 

Readying a different weapon after gaining Nightmare Fuel refreshes its duration. Swapping weapons again removes the buff. 

Scoring a kill with a weapon currently benefitting from Nightmare Fuel grants you a fresh instance of the buff (as if you scored another Powered Melee Kill), allowing you to switch weapons again.
